description:
## What's Changed
* Improve song playback controls with seek and restart behavior by @ingoau in https://github.com/ingoau/huddlefm/pull/2
* Add animated lyrics camera feed to HuddleFM by @ingoau in https://github.com/ingoau/huddlefm/pull/1

* Add a setting to control thread player anchoring by @ingoau in https://github.com/ingoau/huddlefm/pull/4
* Support concurrent Slack Huddle sessions by @ingoau in https://github.com/ingoau/huddlefm/pull/5
* Add permission presets to huddle settings by @ingoau in https://github.com/ingoau/huddlefm/pull/6
* Add YouTube Music autoplay recommendations by @ingoau in https://github.com/ingoau/huddlefm/pull/7

* Refine Huddle UI copy and permission labels by @ingoau in https://github.com/ingoau/huddlefm/pull/9
* Join active Huddles when mentioned in their threads by @ingoau in https://github.com/ingoau/huddlefm/pull/10
